description: Alpha Agent Stage 8 - autonomous data exhaustion, never-idle research queue, watchdog and secure Telegram control plane. RESEARCH AUTOMATION ONLY. Never creates orders, fills, signals, trade decisions, model promotions, Alpha Paper Book changes, Paper Trader DB writes or Daily Close triggers; never runs the prediction service or PostgreSQL. Contains NO secret - only DPAPI credential-store LOCATIONS and non-secret numeric allowlist file references; the Telegram bot token lives exclusively in Windows DPAPI storage outside this repository and the allowed numeric ids live in a non-secret file outside this repository.

operating_principles.exhaustive_data: Exhaust every owned and every legally accessible free source before declaring a signal family blocked; classify every missing field with an exact source attempt and reason.
operating_principles.never_idle: Never voluntarily enter a terminal research-complete / nothing-to-do / waiting-for-user state while useful work remains possible; keep at least one next useful action in the durable queue; one blocked lane never stops the others; a sent report is never terminal.

collect_drain.note: Stage 9.2 (release-closure + SAFE-TIMEOUT correction) - bounded canonical-queue drain integrated into the scheduled AlphaAgent-Collect cycle. SCOPE: restricted to approved Stage-9 tournament-continuation work ONLY, via a three-dimension allowlist (allowed_origins AND allowed_lane_prefixes AND allowed_categories); ineligible/legacy jobs are never claimed, transitioned or counted, and an empty allowlist executes nothing. SEC CONTINUATION POLICY (Option 1 - PAUSED): the drain admits the weakest-gate-originated SEC batch (origin stage9-weakest-gate, lane acq.sec_form4_8k) and executes exactly ONE bounded 20-CIK batch per trigger; the SEC campaign's OWN self-continuation (origin campaign-continuation) is DELIBERATELY excluded from allowed_origins, so the batch chain does NOT auto-perpetuate - a future scoped stage will design controlled continuation with explicit issuer accounting and a stopping condition. AUDIT: attempts increments exactly once per real execution at CLAIM time, so an executed job shows attempts>=1. EXECUTION CONTAINMENT (SAFE TIMEOUT): every handler runs INLINE on the drain thread - there is NO worker/daemon thread and nothing is ever abandoned, so the queue lease is settled strictly AFTER the handler returns and a handler can never keep writing canonical state after its job is settled. The drain admits only internally-bounded handlers: DATA_VALIDATION (weakest-gate) is LOCAL owned-coverage measurement (no network); acq.sec_form4_8k has a finite batch (sec_cik_batch_size=20 CIKs) and finite per-request network timeouts (stage2 http_timeout_seconds=30 x max_retries), and honours handler_time_budget_seconds by stopping BETWEEN bounded network requests and returning RETRYABLE (partial batch not recorded; resumes next cycle; bounded by max_attempts). handler_time_budget_seconds is a COOPERATIVE, inline, handler-enforced bound and is NOT a hard process kill; budget_seconds likewise only prevents STARTING a new job once the per-cycle wall-clock is spent. The HARD, OS-enforced ceilings are the task ExecutionTimeLimit (PT20M) and MultipleInstancesPolicy=IgnoreNew (no overlapping cycle); the runtime collect lock refuses a second in-host collect; an OS kill mid-handler leaves the job RUNNING (never settled) for requeue_stale to recover. Absent/false = disabled (offline + acceptance/test configs never drain); true here = production default. Durable lease semantics: a claimed job is RUNNING and cannot be double-claimed; a restart resumes leased/retryable work.

tournament.note: Stage 9 Autonomous Alpha Tournament. The bounded tournament tick is the highest-value research step of the production cycle (run_autonomy_cycle(..., run_tournament=True)); it shares THIS durable queue and never creates a second framework. READ-ONLY w.r.t. the operating portfolio; no automatic promotion.

production_handlers.note: Real Stage 2/5/6 handlers: each durable-queue category acquires real data or runs a real bounded experiment and returns genuine evidence (record counts, coverage deltas, rank-IC, gate decisions). Research-only; never writes an operational ledger.

production.note: WS2 — TWO explicit run modes. Scheduled production tasks resolve run_mode=production and dynamically shard the COMPLETE eligible research universe (Norgate survivorship-safe 'S&P 500 Current & Past' incl. delisted). A per-job batch size is permitted; a permanent total-universe cap is NOT. The six-symbol 'bounded_universe' above is the ACCEPTANCE fixture (tests / smoke / manual acceptance) and is never selected by a scheduled task. Durable cursors + repair queues live in the campaign store; each completed batch enqueues the next (autonomous continuation).

production_universe_source.note: licensed Norgate survivorship-safe universe: current + past S&P 500 constituents INCLUDING delisted securities for point-in-time research
